_doc: Per-vault Oracle memory isolation. BOTH lists empty = OFF (one shared memory, tenant_id='default').
_step1_label: vaults: {'<vault-dir>': '<tenant>'} tags that vault's docs on the next reindex. Tagging alone hides NOTHING — readers without ORACLE_TENANT_ID still see every tenant. Backfill old docs: bun ~/.claude/oracle-tenant-migrate.ts --report (dry-run) then --apply.
_step2_isolate: isolateReads: ['<vault-dir>'] makes that oracle's MCP see ONLY its own tenant (+ nothing else). This is the switch that actually isolates. Remove the entry to un-isolate; no data changes.
_off: Set both back to empty. Undo the labels with: bun ~/.claude/oracle-tenant-migrate.ts --revert ~/.oracle/tenant-migrate-<stamp>.jsonl
_example: label mike-oracle as tenant 'mike', then add the same vault name to the isolate list below
_perf: The PreToolUse guard hook fast-paths on a grep for a NON-empty isolate list at the start of a line — keep the real key at 2-space indent, and never write a filled-in example of it in this file or the hook pays a python start (~35ms) on every tool call for nothing.
